title: Automatic deceleration limit under a braking lead vehicle
objective: Show that while ACC is in Active-Cruise or Active-Follow the automatic deceleration of the subject vehicle stays within the 2 s moving-average limit of 3,5 m/s^2 stated by ACC-SYS-PRF-020, when a lead vehicle brakes at 3 m/s^2.
entry_criteria: A plant MF4 for scenario lead_brake_3mps2 is ingested and vectorised.
exit_criteria: Every criterion of this case has a verdict.

preconditions.prose: ACC main switch on and ACC engaged (ACC_Status in Active-Cruise or Active-Follow). The engagement window is expressed as a state mask on the criterion rather than as a gate, so a trace that never engages produces no samples and the criterion says so.

steps.action: Drive the subject vehicle at the set speed with ACC engaged and a lead vehicle ahead.
Brake the lead vehicle at 3 m/s^2 until the closing manoeuvre is resolved.
steps.expected: The subject vehicle decelerates without exceeding the deceleration limit.

pass_criteria.description: 2 s moving average of longitudinal acceleration never below -3,5 m/s^2 while engaged.

notes: Demo seed case authored for the local stack. The threshold and the 2 s averaging window are quoted from ACC-SYS-PRF-020; the signal names come from the plant channel table in acc_stim/mf4/signals.py.

title: Automatic acceleration limit on set-speed approach
objective: Show that while ACC is in Active-Cruise or Active-Follow the automatic acceleration of the subject vehicle never exceeds the 2,0 m/s^2 limit stated by ACC-SYS-PRF-022, while the vehicle accelerates to the selected set speed.
entry_criteria: A plant MF4 for scenario cruise_set_speed is ingested and vectorised.
exit_criteria: Every criterion of this case has a verdict.

preconditions.prose: ACC engaged with no in-lane target closer than the selected clearance, so the controller is speed-limited rather than gap-limited.

steps.action: Engage ACC at a speed below the selected set speed on a clear lane.
Let the system accelerate to the set speed.
steps.expected: Longitudinal acceleration stays within the acceleration limit.

pass_criteria.description: Peak longitudinal acceleration at most 2,0 m/s^2 while engaged.

notes: Demo seed case authored for the local stack. The 2,0 m/s^2 bound is quoted from ACC-SYS-PRF-022.

title: Minimum steady-state clearance floor while following
objective: Show that while ACC is in Active-Follow or Active-Hold under steady-state conditions the clearance to the selected target never falls below the 2,5 m floor of ACC-SYS-PRF-003. This case asserts the fixed floor only; the time-gap product term of the requirement needs a derived signal and is not covered here.
entry_criteria: A plant MF4 for scenario follow_steady_timegap is ingested and vectorised.
exit_criteria: Every criterion of this case has a verdict.

preconditions.prose: A single in-lane lead vehicle at constant speed, ACC following it with the shortest selectable time gap.

steps.action: Follow a lead vehicle at constant speed with ACC engaged and the shortest time gap selected.
Hold the steady-state following condition for the duration of the trace.
steps.expected: Clearance to the selected target stays above the floor.

pass_criteria.description: Minimum clearance to the selected target at least 2,5 m while following or holding.

notes: Demo seed case authored for the local stack. The 2,5 m floor is quoted from ACC-SYS-PRF-003; the product term (selected time gap times subject speed) is deliberately out of scope.
